views.looks_at: 英伟达是否在2027-07-26或之前完成为OpenAI俄亥俄州南部数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保的安排；该拟议担保覆盖数据中心租赁和债务融资，不包括中心内的英伟达芯片。
views.question: 到2027-07-26，英伟达是否已完成为OpenAI俄亥俄州南部数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保的安排？

view_keys.scope: OpenAI俄亥俄州南部数据中心项目约2500亿美元融资担保
view_keys.scope_key: openai俄亥俄州南部数据中心项目约2500亿美元融资担保

rungs.label: 是
rungs.condition: 截至2027-07-26，英伟达已完成该约2500亿美元融资担保安排。

rungs.label: 否
rungs.condition: 截至2027-07-26，英伟达未完成该约2500亿美元融资担保安排。

evidence.quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.
evidence.one_line: Reuters转述《华尔街日报》称，英伟达正与OpenAI洽谈为数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保。
evidence.speaker: Reuters
evidence.event_time: Reuters报道于2026-07-27；所引《华尔街日报》报道于2026-07-26

evidence.quote: The backstop from Nvidia would help the ChatGPT maker lease a 10-gigawatt project that ‌SoftBank's subsidiary SB Energy is developing in southern Ohio, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》引述知情人士称，英伟达担保将帮助OpenAI租赁SB Energy在俄亥俄州南部开发的10吉瓦项目。
evidence.speaker: Reuters
evidence.original_who: The Wall Street Journal（引述知情人士）
evidence.event_time: Reuters报道于2026-07-27；所引《华尔街日报》报道于2026-07-26

evidence.quote: The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》称，拟议的2500亿美元担保覆盖数据中心租赁和债务融资、不覆盖英伟达芯片；英伟达另在讨论为最高3500亿美元的OpenAI芯片采购提供融资。
evidence.speaker: Reuters
evidence.event_time: Reuters报道于2026-07-27；所引《华尔街日报》报道于2026-07-26

evidence.quote: Reuters could not immediately verify the report. Nvidia, OpenAI and the U.S. Commerce ‌Department did not respond to requests for comment.
evidence.one_line: 截至Reuters报道时，Reuters未能立即核实该报道，英伟达、OpenAI和美国商务部未回应置评请求。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: While ​OpenAI is valued at $852 billion, making it ‌one of the most valuable private companies, the startup still remains unprofitable, raising questions about its ability to fund the multi-billion-dollar commitments it has signed for AI infrastructure.
evidence.one_line: Reuters称，OpenAI估值为8520亿美元但仍未盈利，其履行已签署的数十亿美元AI基础设施承诺的能力因此受到质疑。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: Nvidia's backing would support financing vehicles aimed ​at ​reassuring lenders about the project's funding, the report added.
evidence.one_line: Reuters转述报道称，英伟达的支持将用于支持融资工具，以增强贷款方对项目资金的信心。
evidence.speaker: Reuters
evidence.event_time: Reuters报道于2026-07-27；所引《华尔街日报》报道于2026-07-26

evidence.quote: The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》报道称，俄亥俄州设施可能耗资超过5000亿美元，并将成为迄今宣布的最大数据中心项目。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: Even though it remains to be seen how a hypothetical deal would be structured, Seaport Research's Jay Goldberg is cautious on this sort of arrangement.
evidence.one_line: 截至2026-07-27，MarketWatch称拟议安排的具体结构仍未明朗，Seaport Research的Jay Goldberg对这类安排持谨慎态度。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: "I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
evidence.one_line: Seaport Research的Jay Goldberg表示，他不了解安排的全部细节，也不确定其真实性；若交易发生，他认为英伟达难以证明其合理性。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg / Seaport Research

evidence.quote: Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
evidence.one_line: Jay Goldberg指出，企业过去曾因融资支持客户购买而陷入困境。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch（转述Jay Goldberg）

evidence.quote: "These kinds of financing usually don't end well," Goldberg added.
evidence.one_line: Jay Goldberg表示，这类融资通常结局不佳。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg / Seaport Research

evidence.quote: Shares of Nvidia lost 5% in Monday's trading.
evidence.one_line: 英伟达股价在2026-07-27周一交易中下跌5%。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: "Investor feedback late last night was a combination of this being the clearest/largest circular-financing headline we've seen so far and we're not entirely new to this circular-financing debacle," Jefferies technology strategist Jeffrey Favuzza said in a note to clients.
evidence.one_line: Jefferies技术策略师Jeffrey Favuzza在客户报告中转述投资者反馈，称这被视为迄今最明显、规模最大的循环融资新闻之一，且市场对循环融资问题并不陌生。
evidence.speaker: Jeffrey Favuzza / Jefferies（经Hannah Pedone转述）

evidence.quote: Nvidia already has committed to investments in OpenAI, and also amended some of the earlier terms of such arrangements.
evidence.one_line: 截至2026-07-27，MarketWatch报道称英伟达已承诺投资OpenAI，并修改过部分较早安排的条款。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: In February, the Financial Times reported that Nvidia was pulling out from a $100 billion agreement originally announced in September, and replacing it with a $30 billion equity investment.
evidence.one_line: MarketWatch转述《金融时报》报道，英伟达在2026年2月退出一项最初于2025年9月宣布的1000亿美元协议，并以300亿美元股权投资取代。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

members.question: 到2027-07-26，英伟达是否已完成为OpenAI俄亥俄州南部数据中心项目提供约2500亿美元融资担保的安排？

evidence.quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.

The backstop from Nvidia would help the ChatGPT maker lease a 10-gigawatt project that ‌SoftBank's subsidiary SB Energy is developing in southern Ohio, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.

The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report. Nvidia, OpenAI and the U.S. Commerce ‌Department did not respond to requests for comment.

While ​OpenAI is valued at $852 billion, making it ‌one of the most valuable private companies, the startup still remains unprofitable, raising questions about its ability to fund the multi-billion-dollar commitments it has signed for AI infrastructure.
Nvidia's backing would support financing vehicles aimed ​at ​reassuring lenders about the project's funding, the report added.
The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
Even though it remains to be seen how a hypothetical deal would be structured, Seaport Research's Jay Goldberg is cautious on this sort of arrangement.
"I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
"These kinds of financing usually don't end well," Goldberg added.
Shares of Nvidia lost 5% in Monday's trading.

"Investor feedback late last night was a combination of this being the clearest/largest circular-financing headline we've seen so far and we're not entirely new to this circular-financing debacle," Jefferies technology strategist Jeffrey Favuzza said in a note to clients.
Nvidia already has committed to investments in OpenAI, and also amended some of the earlier terms of such arrangements.
In February, the Financial Times reported that Nvidia was pulling out from a $100 billion agreement originally announced in September, and replacing it with a $30 billion equity investment.
